run_SENTEVAL_evaluation: run SentEval evaluation on transfer tasks using Google Universal Sentence Encoder embeddings
create_embed_fn: create an embedding function from a TensorFlow Hub module URL that returns sentence embeddings
build_batcher: build a batcher function that joins sentence tokens and returns Google USE embeddings for a batch
test_SENTEVAL_tasks: test SentEval engine with a list of transfer tasks including STS, sentiment, and linguistic similarity benchmarks
review_prepare_batcher: review the prepare and batcher functions used as SentEval callbacks for embedding-based evaluation
